messages.content: Who is the most assist player in Premier League?

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

message.content: Could you clarify which season you’re interested in? For example, are you asking about the most assists in the current 2025/26 season, the previous 2024/25 season, or the all‑time record in the Premier League?

Or provide general answer: "As of 2023/24, the top assist provider is ...". But we don't have data for 2023/24. We can say: "Kevin De Bruyne has been the top assist provider in recent seasons."
